structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. From the page, the ones worth looking into are the קרן השתלמות I already have, a קרן כספית for money I might need soon, and a חשבון ניירות ערך so I can buy an S&P 500 fund. The page doesn't say what any of them costs or what to do first with 30,000.

stuck.where: The grid of cards after 'איפה הכסף מוחזק'
stuck.why: Too many boxes that look alike and nothing saying which one is for someone like me
About a dozen indexes (MSCI AC World, MSCI World, נאסד"ק, ת"א) look the same; couldn't tell how they differ
The same word shows up in both sections, so I wasn't sure if they're the same thing

used: 'מאיפה להתחיל' list: קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן כספית
skimmed: 'כסף שוטף וקצר' cards (עו"ש, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון, קרן כספית)
unsure_meaning: MSCI AC World vs MSCI World
not_found: Any fee numbers, especially in shekels
Any recommendation for someone with about 30,000 ₪ to invest
A first concrete step to take
Returns or any numbers at all
Which banks or investment houses offer these

findings.what: No numbers at all, no fees, no returns, so I can't judge whether anything is worth it
S&P 500, the thing I came for, isn't in 'מאיפה להתחיל'; it's buried deep in the index grid
About 25 similar-looking cards with no hint of which ones fit a young employee
findings.where: 'איפה הכסף מוחזק' and 'במה הכסף מושקע' grids

findings.what: Jargon in card text (מק"מ, צמודה, מנוטרלת) without plain explanation
מק"מ appears twice in different sections, which is confusing
Doesn't explain that I need a חשבון ניירות ערך to buy the S&P index; I had to put it together myself
